## Load data
allMuts <- data.table::fread("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/vcf_ds_cleaned.txt") %>% as.data.frame()

###########################################
## Process and plot figure by individual ##

#########
## UC7 ##
all_res <- allMuts %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "UC7", x = sample)) %>% 
  mutate(type = case_when(grepl(pattern = "T", x = sample) ~ "Tumor",
                          grepl(pattern = "N", x = sample) ~ "Normal",
                          grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = sample) ~ "Blood",
                          grepl(pattern = "Urine", x = sample) ~ "Urine"))
all_res <-split(all_res$ID, all_res$type)

p20 <- ggvenn(all_res, c("Tumor", "Normal", "Blood"), show_percentage = FALSE,
              fill_color = c("#4F81BD", "#A6A6A6", "#D7191C"),
              stroke_size = 0.5, set_name_size = 2.4, text_size = 1.8) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    ggtitle("UC7") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.margin = margin(-10, -10, -10, -10, unit = "pt"))

##########

Are variants in blood found in other tissues clonal? (intext analysis)
```{r}
allMuts_summary  <- allMuts %>% mutate(sample = case_when(grepl(pattern = "T", x = sample) ~ "T",
                                                  grepl(pattern = "N", x = sample) ~ "N",
                                                  grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = sample) ~ "B",
                                                  grepl(pattern = "Urine", x = sample) ~ "U")) %>%
  distinct(group, sample, ID) %>%
  group_by(group, ID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(), ## tally sample with variant
    samples = paste(sort(sample), collapse = ","), ## which sample type has it
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

## Select for varaints that are clonal (read>1)
blood_variants_found <- allMuts_summary %>% dplyr::filter(n_samples > 1,
                                                           grepl(pattern = "B", x = samples))
## Table to get raw count
table(blood_variants_found$group)

## Append the blood_variants_found to allMuts to get read depth
filtered_allMuts <- allMuts %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = sample)) %>%
  left_join(x = ., y = blood_variants_found, by = c("group", "ID")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(n_samples))

## Manual calculate proportion
# variants that were detected in both blood as well as any other sample of the same patient were clonal in the blood
table(filtered_allMuts$alt_depth > 1)
55/(66+55)

# variants in blood were clonal
all_blood <- allMuts %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = sample))
table(all_blood$alt_depth > 1)
183/(183+1416)
```

set.seed(602)
combined_plot1 <- wrap_elements(combined_venn) + plot_layout(design=layout) + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c(""))) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 10),
        text = element_text(family = "Arial"))
